gradcam_role: Supporting 2D classifier visualization only. Not a tumor boundary, physical measurement, or validated anatomical localization.
review_requirement: Review each case with the medical collaborator and record whether attention is plausibly intracranial/lesion-related, border/background-driven, diffuse/unclear, or otherwise suspicious.
methodology: Each OOF case uses its own fold checkpoint, which did not train on that validation image.
